column1: # Member and expression rewrites, applied by apply_renames.py.
#   pre    - Python regex, applied BEFORE class renames (can match old class names)
#   member - method/field name after a '.', i.e. regex \.old\b -> .new
#            Only MCP names that are unambiguous in this codebase belong here.
#   post   - Python regex, applied AFTER class renames
# --- expressions that depend on the old class name
# The implicit Java<->Scala conversions moved; the old objects are gone.
# (Migrating to explicit .asScala/.asJava is a later cleanup.)
# Java 11 added String.lines(), which shadows StringOps.lines.
# --- NBT tag constructors are private now; use the factories.
# --- more members found while porting the foundation layer
